title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a First Class Dispensary in Each of the Island Municipalities of Almagro, DARam, Santa Rita, Marabut and Tarangnan, All in the Province of Samar, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a First Class Dispensary in Each of the Island Municipalities of Almagro, DARam, Santa Rita, Marabut and Tarangnan, All in the Province of Samar, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4312_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established under the supervision of the Director of Health Services a first class dispensary in each of the island municipalities of Almagro, Daram, Santa Rita, Marabut and Tarangnan, all in the Province of Samar, to be known as Almagro Dispensary, Daram Dispensary, Santa Rita Dispensary, Marabut Dispensary and Tarangnan Dispensary, respectively.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said dispensaries during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-six: Provided, That each dispensary shall be entitled to twenty thousand pesos. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for the operation and maintenance of said dispensaries shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
